aspect: Being good at it is close to irrelevant
description: Selection runs on role, cost centre and headcount target. Performance rarely determines whether the role exists next quarter.
energy_note: Losing something on grounds that have nothing to do with you.

aspect: The notice is short and the search is not
description: Severance is measured in weeks; a professional search is measured in months. The gap is the household's problem.
The meeting is at 9am and by 9:20 her laptop is locked. Eleven years of files she can no longer reach, including the only copies of things she wrote.
energy_note: Eleven years, ended before the coffee was finished.

aspect: The gap on the CV is read as a signal
description: Six months out is treated as information about the person rather than arithmetic about the market, and the longer it runs the more it reinforces itself.

aspect: Re-entry is usually at a discount
description: The next role commonly pays less, and every subsequent offer is benchmarked against the reduced figure.
energy_note: One quarter's decision, priced into the next twenty years.
